def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the all-zero divider and take the panel before it as the source.
    if any(all(v == 0 for v in row) for row in grid):
        cut = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 0 for v in row))
        source = [row[:] for row in grid[:cut]]
        mask = [row[:] for row in grid[cut + 1:]]
    else:
        cut = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h)))
        source = [row[:cut] for row in grid]
        mask = [row[cut + 1:] for row in grid]

    from collections import Counter
    common = Counter(v for row in source for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mask_bg = Counter(v for row in mask for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for r, row in enumerate(source):
        out_row = []
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            value = 3 if v == common else 9
            if mask[r][c] != mask_bg:
                value = 9
            out_row.append(value)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
